entries.topic: Reconciled D167 PRIMARY liveness contract: successful RTDB heartbeat suppresses Firestore lease refresh while Worker insists on 45-second Firestore heartbeat
facts: Canonical live source relay-agent/FirestoreAgentLeaderCoordinator.cs PrimaryLeaseHeartbeatMs=10000 and PrimaryRoleRefreshMs=60000. In the PRIMARY loop, a successful _rtdbLiveness.WriteHeartbeat(session,_generation) updates _lastLeaseWriteMs in RAM and skips WritePrimaryLease(session). Firestore lease is therefore not periodically refreshed during successful RTDB-only liveness; RefreshRole PRIMARY branch does not unconditionally write it either.

Canonical live source service/src/d167-sku-ha.ts verifyD167AgentPrimary independently checks Firestore roles and the Firestore lease_<generation> document, requiring matching instance+generation and abs(now-heartbeat_at_ms)<=45000ms. It does NOT use RTDB freshness. This is a proven mixed-source/TTL contract mismatch, not proof that all runtime 409 are necessarily this cause.

Field Agent became PRIMARY following a targeted handoff at 06:54:41–42 and Worker emitted 409 NOT_CURRENT_FIREBASE_PRIMARY at 06:55:27 (about 46s later), while WMS export succeeded at 06:55:04. Strong temporal corroboration that the lease expired. Other branches of the Worker boolean check (missing runtime service account, token failure, HTTP failure, identity/generation mismatch) still emit the same error and cannot be excluded without reason-level evidence.

Do not bypass Worker HA check, trust local role alone, copy WMS credentials or blindly switch to accepting stale Firestore leases. WMS API/export and Confirm code are not implicated in this server-authority mismatch.
alternatives: Recommended low-metered design: during an authorized D167 SKU job only, perform a generation-fenced, server-authoritative Firestore lease refresh just before claim/manual-start and keep it fresh at a bounded <=30s cadence while processing chunks/publish. Keep independent Worker Firestore roles+lease checks and fail closed on lost PRIMARY. Test failover at every stage, expired-stale and service timeout/idempotent recoveries. No 24h idle heartbeat writes introduced.

Alternative higher-impact design: Worker verify current Firestore roles plus scoped RTDB liveness with correct read permissions/REST API; validate cross-provider semantics, cost and security before selecting. Do not simply drop the Firestore lease check.
High-usage fallback not preferred: permanently mirror every 10s RTDB heartbeat into Firestore even when no SKU job; imposes continuous Firestore writes, potentially >=6/min during all PRIMARY time.
